title: BIO-RAD LABORATORIES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Bio-Rad Laboratories filed an 8-K reporting results of its April 21, 2026 annual stockholder meeting, including election of directors, ratification of KPMG LLP as auditors, approval of executive compensation, and approval of an amended 2017 Incentive Award Plan. A stockholder proposal to eliminate the company's dual class capital structure was rejected.
key_points: All nominated directors (Melinda Litherland, Arnold A. Pinkston, Jeffrey L. Edwards, Gregory K. Hinckli, Allison Schwartz, Norman Schwartz) were elected across Class A and Class B Common Stock.
KPMG LLP was ratified as independent auditors for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 (7,037,199 votes for vs. 38,994 against).
The Amended 2017 Incentive Award Plan was approved, increasing reserved shares by 335,000 and extending the plan to March 18, 2036.
The non-binding advisory vote to approve executive compensation passed with 6,682,605 votes for, 268,173 against.
A stockholder proposal to eliminate Bio-Rad's dual class capital structure was rejected (5,459,554 votes against vs. 1,469,297 votes for).
why_it_matters: This filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. It pertains solely to a single life sciences company's internal governance matters.
important_numbers: 5,459,554 votes against dual class structure proposal
